facts.fact: 七楼门开时她以为自己看见骷髅：一排排推床上躺着骷髅，一只瘦到只剩骨头的手伸出来，仍然想被触碰。
facts.anchor: The doors swung open, and at first I thought I saw skeletons. Rows of gurneys with skeletons lying on them, a hand wasted down to bones, reaching out, still wanting to be touched.

facts.fact: 幻觉退去——从来没有人；只是丑恶的闪现侵入本就难受的现实。真正在场的是椅子上被 KS 啃掉鼻子的男人；医院灯光下每个人都像病人。
facts.anchor: They were never there, I realized. It was just a flash of something awful, a vision that intruded on an otherwise upsetting reality. I saw a man slumped in a chair with KS chewing off his nose—that was real.

facts.fact: Star 不像 Star、不像任何人：乌青占半张脸，颈侧霓虹色瘀伤直上耳朵，耳旁一角硬币大的 KS 斑——男友一定见过并知道那是什么；她的头被剃过，颅骨上是「科学怪人」式缝线。
facts.anchor: Star did not look like Star. She did not look like anyone. Her black eye was truly black, not purple or mauve or green, and it took up half her face. She had neon bruises along her neck running up to her ear, where there was, small as a dime, a KS spot. The boyfriend must have seen it and known what it was.

facts.fact: Bianca 已在床边：把念珠缠进 Star 的手里，再把自己的手包上去。
facts.anchor: She had wrapped a rosary in Star’s hand and wrapped her hand around Star’s.

facts.fact: Bianca（哭过）：他们说她时不时会醒，药量大所以睡着——「这段时间她一直在这儿，孤零零一个人。」
facts.anchor: “They said she wakes up every so often. She’s on a lot, so she sleeps.” Bianca had been crying. “This whole time she was here, all alone.”

facts.fact: Leon 给邻床病人检查输液、倒尿盆：他是个混蛋，但只要你能把他拖来，危机时刻非常靠得住。
facts.anchor: He was an asshole who was great in a crisis if you could drag him to it.

facts.fact: Bianca 早见过红线：Star 手腕一次青紫，说是容易淤青，被追问时还骂她是嫉妒——「她说我是嫉妒她有人爱她爱到那样抓她。」
facts.anchor: “She was all black and blue on her wrist one time. She said she bruised easy, but when I kept asking her, she was such a cunt about it.” She choked up. “She said I was jealous she had someone who loved her enough to grab her like that.”

facts.fact: 他们为 Star 筹划 bat mitzvah：在 Pyramid Club 举办、以《Lucky Star》入场（她称这首是麦当娜为她写的）、借 Bianca 的金银丝裙、给她做王冠。
facts.anchor: So we planned Star’s bat mitzvah. She could hear us, even if she was somewhere else. We’d throw it at the Pyramid Club. She would make an entrance to “Lucky Star,” which she said Madonna wrote about her. She could borrow Bianca’s gold lamé dress, which would barely cover her crotch, and we’d make a crown for her.

facts.fact: 她没有受宗教教育，不知道仪式该做什么；她不知道 Star 有没有上过希伯来学校、家人是共产党还是在 59 年离开——关于她，有太多她从没问过。
facts.anchor: There was so much about her I’d never asked.

facts.fact: Claude 在班上专业利落；她理解 Claude 需要下班抽离；「这点我可以向她学。也许她也能从我这儿学到点什么。」
facts.anchor: She had so much knowledge, so much competence. She needed time away from it all to keep going, I understood that. I could learn from her there. Maybe she could learn something from me, too.

facts.fact: 她心算：Mark 第一次住院被告知是 PCP，那是 1983 年 11 月，他七个月后去世；她意识到自己对 Mark 的治疗几乎一无所知——苦涩的一秒她想：要是 Star 得到正确治疗活下来、而 Mark 从来没有过呢？我会恨 Star 吗？
facts.anchor: The first time Mark went to the hospital, they told him it was PCP—that was November ’83. He died seven months later. Did he get Bactrim? I realized how little I knew about his treatment, if there even was any. For a bitter second, I thought, what if Star gets the right treatment and she lives, but Mark never did? Would I resent Star?

facts.fact: Claude 说：她自主呼吸不太好，开始用 Bactrim；若有 PCP（看起来是），她的病人里约一半一年内复发。
facts.anchor: She’s not breathing too well on her own, so we’re starting her on Bactrim.”

facts.fact: 他们陪到探视时间结束；三人留宿难，Bianca 留下；她吻 Star 没淤青的额头、说她很美——她活着、在抗争，也许会更糟，也许不会。警察始终没来。
facts.anchor: She was alive and fighting and maybe things would get worse, but it was always possible that maybe they wouldn’t. The cops never showed.

facts.fact: 回家后她第一次拿出速写本，画 Star 的 shayna punim（意第绪语：漂亮脸蛋）——画她痊愈后希望的样子。
facts.anchor: When I got home, I took out my sketchbook for the first time in a while and drew Star’s shayna punim, her beautiful face, as she might like it to look one day when she was healed.

facts.fact: 次日晨听留言：Claude 说很高兴帮她和 Bianca 找到朋友、Star 很强会挺过去、要有耐心——停顿——「我一直在想你。希望你好好照顾自己。」又停顿，然后挂断。
facts.anchor: I’ve been thinking of you. I hope you’re taking good care of yourself.”
